_README: OPTIONAL per-deployment lineup override. Copy this to 'lineup.local.json' in
the helper's DATA DIR (/data in the container — the writable volume; or
$DATA_DIR locally). It is gitignored and is NOT the shipped seed.json, which
you never edit. The helper loads the shipped curated lineup, then reconciles
this on top. No file present => the shipped lineup, identical to today.
Reconcile precedence: 'override' field-merges win over shipped values;
'disable' removes a shipped channel from the picker + prober; 'add' appends a
new channel (a slug that collides with a shipped one is skipped — use
'override' for shipped changes). Every effective channel is validated + probed
like any channel (free/honest-offline rules apply); a bad entry is skipped
with a logged reason, never crashing the whole lineup. Categories: any string
(e.g. Sports / US News / Global News / Business / Weather / Cameras / Nature /
Space / General, or a new one — the clients show unrecognized sections too).
Delete the keys you don't use. The '_README' key is ignored by the loader.
